text: APPROVE: The extracted loop (two foreach, two ifs, nested) accounts for about 8 points of cognitive complexity, so the method drops to about 8, and the LINQ pipeline (`Where(IsScalaType)`, `SelectMany`, `Where(Length > 0)`, `ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal)`) is eager and has the same filtering and ordinal-set semantics as the original loop. I only had the diff, so I haven't confirmed that `IsScalaType` has a single overload or that the project builds with warnings as errors, though the file already uses LINQ (`.Any`) and the new code looks build-safe.
